item.title: Efficient Frontier and Portfolio Optimization
item.description: Covers Markowitz’s mean-variance model as the mathematical foundation for setting asset weights, the two optimal points on the efficient frontier (Min-Variance and Tangency), and the practical adjustments that compensate for the model’s weaknesses.
